title: OSO
description: The armchair within the OSO collection beckons to us with a captivating allure. Its inviting embrace tempts us to sink in and linger—just to remain, indefinitely. Rarely does such voluminous presence exude such an airy comfort. The expansive seat, adorned with premium straps and eco-friendly upholstery, ensnares us in its embrace, refusing to release its hold. Meanwhile, the generous backrest envelops us like the comforting embrace of a dear friend. Its seemingly weightless design provides both stability and liberation, granting us the perfece balance of support and freedom.

title: ONDA
description: ONDA dining sofa is neither a bench nor a sofa. Rather, it is a celebration of shared life at the table—of communicative comfort, a sense of lightness, and a deliberately reduced formal language. The continuous backrest is slightly recessed and does not align flush with the seat. This creates an intriguing geometry from every perspective, allowing the piece to be freely positioned within a space.
